newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Sonae Industria surges on sector prospects.
newsitem.headline: Sonae Industria surges on sector prospects.

text.p: Shares in wood products group Sonae Industria surged 7.3 percent to a record 1,960 escudos on Monday before easing from peaks to 1,926 escudos, still 5.4 percent up on the previous close.
Traders said the stock was being boosted by hopes for good first half results as well as the fact that it had lagged the PSI index over the first half of 1997.
The good performance of its Spanish unit Tafisa was also contributing to the buying interest, they said.
